biography.value:
Oceanus dragons glide along the River Oceanus that winds through the peaceful plane of Elysium. They guide pilgrims and ferry the weary, and they collect beautiful river stones rather than coins. Their silver-teal scales shimmer like sunlight on running water.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .T6Pj91SJ2B2d3CFt]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .30VJeJae89anLER1]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .F9xlBdvB5AhzKy6i]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=SMyCAEh5n5pA3G5l]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=SMyCAEh5n5pA3G5l]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=SMyCAEh5n5pA3G5l]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=edj4w39noGaeFtk7]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Lightning Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a crackling bolt of river lightning in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=6JPalweZBi5whLhS]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=6JPalweZBi5whLhS]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=6JPalweZBi5whLhS]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Euphoria Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its euphoria Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=9Nb5NDjGAI5TRTvC]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=9Nb5NDjGAI5TRTvC]] saving throw or be &Reference[charmed] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 minute, filled with peaceful calm. The effect ends early if the creature takes damage.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • The river rises. Water in a 20-foot square within 120 feet becomes a strong current; each creature there must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 feet.
  • A soothing song rises from the water. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 60 feet regains 10 (3d6) hit points.
  • Lightning arcs between pools. One creature within 60 feet standing in water must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) lightning damage on a failure.
